documents.text: Branch: Bristol Broadmead. Cust Ms I Clarke, ID seen (driving licence). Came in re app outage Fri 30/10. Pays rent (£875) to letting agent by bank transfer on the 30th every month, due date is the 30th. Tried app from approx 8am, error 'something went wrong', tried online banking on a laptop at lunch, same. Rang the phone line, held 40+ mins & gave up (on her lunch break, works in a nursery so can't have phone on her in the afternoon). Paid it Sat morning 31/10. Letting agent (Ashdown Property Lettings, contact Mr Okafor) charged a £25 late payment fee under the tenancy agreement - cust showed me the email on her phone, fee dated 31/10. Cust wants the £25 back and 'an acknowledgement that it was your fault not mine'. Says she has never been late with rent & is worried about her reference with the agent. Vuln check done - none identified, cust confident with the app normally. Explained outage was bank-wide & complaint will be logged, complaints team will contact her within 3 working days and may be able to resolve then. Cust prefers text/email, mob 07700 900 451 confirmed. Imani was very polite but frustrated. - DK
